source.claim: Feature-level compatibility with explicit native, approximation, visual, preservation, and blocked states.

fidelityStates.label: Native
fidelityStates.description: Represented directly in the destination format.

fidelityStates.label: Editable approximation
fidelityStates.description: Retained as editable content with a documented approximation.

fidelityStates.label: Closest representation
fidelityStates.description: Mapped to the closest supported representation, with a reported fidelity difference.

fidelityStates.label: Visual fallback
fidelityStates.description: Appearance retained as a static image when editability is unavailable.

fidelityStates.label: Preserved records
fidelityStates.description: Original records retained without claiming full editing semantics.

fidelityStates.label: Opaque content
fidelityStates.description: Content carried without interpreting its internal feature semantics.

fidelityStates.label: Source retained
fidelityStates.description: Original source embedded with hash verification for recovery.

fidelityStates.label: Blocked
fidelityStates.description: Operation refused when proceeding would silently misrepresent the result.

fidelityStates.label: Not applicable
fidelityStates.description: The operation does not apply to this feature or format direction.

fidelityStates.label: Not implemented
fidelityStates.description: The contract explicitly records a path that is not implemented yet.

fidelityStates.label: No destination equivalent
fidelityStates.description: The destination format has no representation for this feature.

fidelityStates.label: Dropped with diagnostics
fidelityStates.description: The feature is omitted and reported as known loss.
